regime_context: The detector shows Base Metals & Copper as the highest-momentum theme with full eligibility, broad participation, and no crowding. Gold Miners are a strong second with trend-like persistence. Nearly all themes pass the trend gate (eligible fraction 0.88), historically a drawdown-control filter in this market (gate_helps true). Momentum rank itself has no predictive edge; our leans are conditional on trend continuation, not a forecast.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners possibly challenging Base Metals for momentum leadership: condition – Gold Miners rank score exceeds Base Metals rank score for 5 consecutive trading days.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: The theme leads with the highest momentum score, full breadth, and a durability bar of 0.7. It is eligible per the drawdown-control trend gate and is not crowded. While momentum rank is not a return forecast, eligibility and trend coherence support a directional lean in line with the ongoing narrative.
theses.dissent: Commodity themes are highly cyclical; a global demand shock or macro risk-off event could reverse base metals quickly, irrespective of technical strength.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO drops below its 200-day moving average and closes there for 3 consecutive trading days before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners rank second with a trending Hurst exponent and high durability (0.79), suggesting persistent directional moves. The theme is eligible and not crowded. While we are not predicting a leadership handoff, the trend structure supports a positive lean alongside macro uncertainty (coincident geopolitical/macro backdrop).
theses.dissent: A sustained rise in real yields or fading geopolitical tensions could undermine gold miner performance, even with current momentum.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO loses eligibility (falls below the trend gate threshold) at any point before the check-by date

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology ranks near the bottom (#15) with a negative score and is flagged as crowded. Although it remains eligible, the combination of weak momentum rank and crowding—a known sizing caution—warrants an underweight lean. This is not a call to fade the (non-dominant) theme, but to acknowledge higher mean-reversion risk.
theses.dissent: Technology may suddenly benefit from the dominant AI macro narrative or risk-on flows, causing a sharp reversal that overcomes the weak momentum signal.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO’s rank score turns positive and it breaks into the top 5 on the detector ranking before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
